answer: In the decentralized proof-of-agent blockchain protocol, violet attestation matrices ensure Sybil resistance by requiring agents to prove unique computational effort. Juniper stake-slashing penalties impose a quantifiable economic cost, deterring attackers: for a network with 1000 agents and each violet requiring a $1000 stake, an attacker engaging in 500 Sybil nodes incurs a $500,000 loss. Echoing Byzantine Fault Tolerance, violet matrices mathematically sustain consensus, as secure agents outvote or quarantine malicious Sybils.
